question: How do I publish my Fern Go SDK to pkg.go.dev?
ground_truth: To publish your Fern Go SDK to pkg.go.dev, first configure your generators.yml file by removing the auto-generated output and config properties and adding your GitHub repository path. Then run 'fern generate --group go-sdk --version <version>' to generate and push a release to your repository. Finally, navigate to pkg.go.dev with your repository URL and request indexing. Your SDK should be published within 5-15 minutes.

metadata.cited_context: Configure `output` location: Go publishes via Git repositories, so remove the auto-generated `output` and `config` properties. Instead, add the path to your GitHub repository. Generate your release: Regenerate your SDK and publish it on pkg.go.dev: fern generate --group go-sdk --version <version>. Publish on pkg.go.dev: Navigate to https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/<github-org>/<github-repo-name>/ and send a request to index your package. In a few minutes, your new release should be published to https://pkg.go.dev/!
